notes:
Debug-signed Android development build for sideloading, not a store build. The Windows development installer and updater archive are included in the same release.

Built with the legacy (unprofiled) build path while the profiled pilot is checked. Backend: none. Catalog: https://staging-catalog.g3tech.net. Payments/licenses: https://staging-pay.g3tech.net.

Includes the shared g3-brand updater fix (800a257): installing a Windows update now waits for the installer to take over before the app exits.
